definitions: To form an opinion or make a decision about someone or something based solely on their outward appearance or initial impression, without considering their true nature or content.
To make a premature judgment based on superficial characteristics.
examples: Don't judge a book by its cover; he may seem quiet but he's very knowledgeable.
I almost didn't try that restaurant, but I learned not to judge a book by its cover; the food was amazing.
It's easy to judge a book by its cover when you first meet someone, but it's important to get to know them.
lemma: to judge a book by its cover
source: to judge a book by its cover
